definitions.gloss: agency; dealer; authorized agent; representative office
definitions.explanation: A business that acts on behalf of another company — selling products, providing services, or handling transactions as an authorized representative.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{航空|こうくう}{券|けん}→航空券：19426_koukuuken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked a plane ticket at a travel agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{代理店|だいりてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where is the authorized dealer for this car?

examples.japanese: {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: We asked the advertising agency to plan a new campaign.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{代理|だいり}→代理：03422_dairi⟧ (proxy, agent) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop, business). Very common in business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行|りょこう}{代理店|だいりてん}: travel agency
- {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}: advertising agency
- ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧{代理店|だいりてん}: insurance agency
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{代理店|だいりてん}: authorized dealer
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧{代理店|だいりてん}: sales agent/distributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{代理人|だいりにん}→代理人：18508_dairinin⟧: agent (a person, not a business)
- ⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧: retail shop (sells directly, may not be an agent)
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: broker, intermediary
